genre.zh: 慢生活雜誌（Kinfolk）的冥想專題
genre.en: a Kinfolk slow-living editorial on meditation: soft morning light, natural materials, stillness, real hands and quiet rooms

s: the singing bowl rests on a linen cloth on a low wooden table in a deep-teal room, one shaft of hard window light falling on its hammered rim
a hand strikes the rim with the wooden mallet, ripples standing on the water inside, warm side light against a dark plum wall

a trainee holding a full-weight tree pose on the wooden floor of the Taichung training studio, filling the frame, against a deep terracotta-orange wall, hard late-afternoon sun from a tall window on the left throwing her long sharp shadow across the floorboards

the open course manual lies on a rolled-up yoga mat beside a hand-drawn anatomy chart, on a worn wooden studio floor against a deep teal wall, one hard shaft of window light from the right casting the page edges and mat in crisp shadow

a close low-angle shot of a teacher's hands adjusting a trainee's hip in a seated forward fold, inside a real classroom with a muted tomato-red wall, strong side light from a window on the right drawing clear shadows of both bodies on the mat

a row of trainees in a wide warrior pose seen from the floor level, their legs large in the foreground, against a sage-green studio wall, hard morning sun from behind the camera on the left stretching their shadows across the wooden floor

the two framed international certificates leaning on a wooden shelf in the training classroom beside a stack of folded blankets, against a deep ocean-blue wall, a hard beam of low sun from the left throwing the frame shadows long across the shelf

a large metal singing bowl sitting in a trainee's open palm in a real teaching room, filling the frame, against a dark ochre wall, a single hard window beam from the upper right making the rim glint and casting a crisp round shadow on the wall

the bowl, mallet and a mudra hand resting on a wool floor cushion on the training-room floor, against a deep burgundy wall, low hard sun from the left throwing long sharp shadows of the bowl across the floorboards

two trainees facing each other on the floor practising one-on-one, a big singing bowl on the head-side of the client lying down, against a muted moss-green wall, hard side light from a tall window on the right drawing clear shadows across the mat

a close shot of the mallet circling the rim of a bowl set on a wooden classroom table beside a notebook of the self-healing SOP, against a deep teal wall, hard light from the left making the notebook and bowl shadows sharp

a row of classical bowls of different sizes lined up on the training-studio floor in front of a terracotta-orange wall, the largest bowl big in the foreground, hard afternoon sun from the side casting their long shadows across the floor

a trainee sitting cross-legged in meditation on a round cushion on the training-room floor, filling the frame, against a deep midnight-blue wall, one hard beam of low morning sun from the left throwing a long, crisp shadow of the seated figure across the wooden floor
the open Yoga Sutras book and a wooden mala resting on a cushion in the classroom, against a mustard-yellow wall, hard window light from the right making the page edges and beads cast sharp shadows

a group of trainees seated in a row with eyes closed, their silhouettes big in the foreground, against a muted sage-green studio wall, hard sun from tall windows behind them throwing long parallel shadows across the floor toward the camera

a close side view of hands in a meditation mudra resting on knees on a grey-green cushion in a real teaching room, against a deep terracotta wall, strong directional light from the left carving clear shadows on the fingers and the floor

the quiet classroom at dawn, one bolster and blanket placed in the middle of a wooden floor against a rich ocean-blue wall, a hard slab of sunlight from a window on the right falling across the cushion and stretching its shadow
